Different body skin concerns need different approaches — so here are 5 easy picks to know 👇

Armpit odor → Benzoyl Peroxide
Strawberry skin → Urea
Body acne → Salicylic Acid

text:
Damaged skin barrier: True or False? Lindsey👩🏻‍⚕️💊 breaks it down 👇

1️⃣ Stinging = damaged barrier? ✅ True
If your usual products suddenly sting or burn, your barrier's letting things in that it normally keeps out.

2️⃣ More products = faster fix? ❌ False
It's the opposite. Cut back to a gentle cleanser, a moisturizer, and sunscreen. Less is more right now.

3️⃣ Ceramides help? ✅  True
Ceramides make up about half of the fats in your skin barrier. Putting them back helps patch the gaps.

4️⃣ Oily skin can't be damaged? ❌ False
Oily skin gets damaged too, usually from over-cleansing. Oily on top, tight and flaky underneath? That's your sign.

5️⃣ Exfoliating every day is fine? ❌ False
That's one of the fastest ways to wreck your barrier. Pause all acids and scrubs until your skin calms down.

6️⃣ Heals in 2–3 days? ❌  False
It usually takes a few weeks. Keep it simple and stay consistent.

Your barrier doesn't need more stuff. It needs a break ✨
